service.name: Live band karaoke
service.serviceType: Live band karaoke for company parties, after-parties and private events
service.description: A live band that plays 80s and 90s hits as a party band and hands the microphone to guests who want to sing, with lyrics on a screen and a host, for company holiday parties, sales kickoffs, after-parties and private events across Denver and Colorado.

faqs.a: No. The band plays a full set of 80s and 90s hits on its own, sung out front, and the night works as a party band night if nobody ever takes the mic. The karaoke is an open door, not an obligation, and the host keeps it open all night.

faqs.q: What if nobody volunteers at first?
faqs.a: That is the usual start, and it is why the band opens with its own set rather than an empty stage and a sign-up sheet. The host works the floor, the first singers are almost always a pair or a group, and the band covers the harmony and the high notes for whoever is up there. Once two or three songs have gone well the list fills on its own.

faqs.q: How is this different from a karaoke DJ?
faqs.a: A backing track asks a guest to perform. A band lets a guest join it. The tempo follows the singer, the band vamps if somebody loses the verse, a second voice comes in on the chorus, and the song ends when it should rather than when the file does. The words are on a screen either way; what changes is who is standing behind the singer.

The songbook runs from the 80s and 90s onward, the songs an office of mixed ages all know: Journey, Bon Jovi, Whitney Houston, Prince, Madonna, Queen, Oasis, No Doubt, Alanis Morissette, TLC, the Backstreet Boys, Outkast, the Killers. It is printed and on the screen, and a specific song for a specific person is a request we take before the night.

faqs.q: How much space and power does the act need?
faqs.a: The four-piece plays in 14 by 10 feet on two dedicated 20-amp circuits with a 90-minute load-in, plus a lyric screen facing the stage and one facing the crowd. Sound sized to the venue is included, and a dedicated announcement microphone is live on its own channel from the end of sound check, so remarks and a raffle get a working mic of their own.

faqs.q: Can the karaoke follow a dinner set?
faqs.a: Yes. The same band plays dinner at conversation volume, 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table, and turns the night when the program ends. One contract, one load-in, one sound system, and the karaoke chapter is placed against your run of show the week before.
